title: TenantSecurityNotificationRule - Data API
description: Stores an alert configured in the Security Center Alerts feature to notify recipients of changes made to security settings. For more information, see Create Alerts for Security Changes. This object is available to Security Center subscribers in API version 53.0 and later.

MetricsType.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Nillable, Sort, Update
MetricsType.description: The type of data being collected.

Name.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update
Name.description: The name of the metric for which data is being collected.

NotificationRuleIdentifier.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update
NotificationRuleIdentifier.description: The ID of the alert that was triggered. This field is unique within your organization.

NotificationType.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Nillable, Sort, Update
NotificationType.description: The type of notification used for the alert. The options are: Email In-App

Operator.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Operator.description: The operator for the change that triggered the alert. For example, greater than.

RecipientEmails.description: The email addresses for the recipients of the alert details.

RuleName.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update
RuleName.description: The name of the custom alert that triggered the notification. This field is unique within your organization.

Status.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Nillable, Sort, Update
Status.description: The status of the alert setting. The options are: Active Draft Inactive

Threshold.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Threshold.description: The threshold value that triggered the alert.

TriggerType.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
TriggerType.description: The type of trigger used for the alert. The values are: Always On Change

Version.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Version.description: The version number of the custom alert.

associated_objects:
This object has these associated objects. If the API version isn’t specified, it’s available in the same API versions as this object. Otherwise, it’s available in the specified API version and later.

- **TenantSecurityNotificationRuleChangeEvent**: Change events are available for the object.
- **TenantSecurityNotificationRuleFeed**: Feed tracking is available for the object.
- **TenantSecurityNotificationRuleHistory**: History is available for tracked fields of the object.
- **TenantSecurityNotificationRuleOwnerSharingRule**: Sharing rules are available for the object.
- **TenantSecurityNotificationRuleShare**: Sharing is available for the object.
